require 'async'
require 'async/http'
require 'async/http/endpoint'
require 'async/http/protocol'

require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/app'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/router'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/methods'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/request'
require 'fluent/log/console_adapter'

module Fluent
  module PluginHelper
    module HttpServer
      class Server
        # @param logger [Logger]
        # @param default_app [Object] This method must have #call.
        # @param tls_context [OpenSSL::SSL::SSLContext]
        def initialize(addr:, port:, logger:, default_app: nil, tls_context: nil)
          @addr = addr
          @port = port
          @logger = logger
          @tls_context = tls_context
          @http_routes = { get: {}, head: {}, post: {}, put: {}, patch: {}, delete: {}, connect: {}, options: {}, trace: {} }
          @http_default_app = default_app || Router::NotFoundApp

          # TODO: support http2
          scheme = tls_context ? 'https' : 'http'
          @uri = URI("#{scheme}://#{@addr}:#{@port}").to_s
          @router = Router.new(default_app)
          @router.bind_http_server(self)
          @reactor = Async::Reactor.new(nil, logger: Fluent::Log::ConsoleAdapter.wrap(@logger))

          opts = if tls_context
                   { ssl_context: tls_context }
                 else
                   {}
                 end
          app = App.new(@router, @logger)
          app.bind_http_server(self)
          @server = Async::HTTP::Server.new(app, Async::HTTP::Endpoint.parse(@uri, **opts))
          capture_http_listen_profile(scheme, tls_context)

          if block_given?
            yield(self)
          end
        end

        def start(notify = nil)
          @logger.debug("Start async HTTP server listening #{@uri}")
          capture_http_start_profile(notify)
          task = @reactor.run do
            @server.run

            if notify
              notify.push(:ready)
            end
          end

          task.stop
          @logger.debug('Finished HTTP server')
        end

        def stop
          @logger.debug('closing HTTP server')

          if @reactor
            @reactor.stop
          end
          capture_http_stop_profile
        end

        HttpServer::Methods::ALL.map { |e| e.downcase.to_sym }.each do |name|
          define_method(name) do |path, app = nil, &block|
            unless path.end_with?('/')
              path << '/'
            end

            if (block && app) || (!block && !app)
              raise 'You must specify either app or block in the same time'
            end

            @router.mount(name, path, app || block)
          end
        end

        def self.merge_transport_settings(config, opts, params)
          conf = config.dup
          params.map(&:to_s).each do |param|
            if opts.key?(param)
              conf[param] = opts[param]
            end
          end
          conf
        end

        def self.split_request_target(path)
          path.split('?', 2)
        end

        def register_http_route(method, path, app)
          capture_http_route_profile(method, path)

          if table
